title: Quiz: Delegation Patterns
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed by Luis.
Content may drift from source; verify against current main.

questions.scenario: In the Coordinator pattern, how much parent context does the worker receive?
questions.explanation: Coordinator synthesizes findings into precise, self-contained specs. Workers start fresh.

questions.scenario: A forked child tries to create another fork. What happens?
questions.explanation: Recursive fork guard prevents context explosion by blocking nested forks.

questions.scenario: In the Swarm pattern, can peers spawn new peers?
questions.explanation: Swarm uses a flat roster. Peers claim tasks from the queue but cannot add new peers.

questions.scenario: What tools does a read_only worker get?
options: Only read_file, list_directory, calculator, datetime, web_search
questions.explanation: read_only workers are filtered to a safe set of read-only tools.

questions.scenario: Where do worker configuration files live?
questions.explanation: Worker configs are YAML files in the .cogentrex/agents/ directory.
